sentences.text:
Smt Deepa Baghel And Others
 Versus
 Sirajuddin And Others
 Appearance:
 Mr. Arvind Kumar Mangal - Advocate for applicants.
 Mr. S.S. Kushwaha - Govt. Advocate for State.
 Order
This application under Order 44 Rule 1 CPC has been filed seeking permission to file this appeal as an indigent person.

2. It is fairly conceded by counsel for applicants/appellants that a part of compensation amount has already been received, and court fee, which would be payable, is less than what was received by applicants/appellants.
3. Accordingly, counsel for applicants/appellants prays for and is granted a month's time to pay the court fee.
If so desire, appellants/applicants may also reduce the valuation of appeal.
4. With aforesaid observations, application under Order 44 Rule 1 CPC is hereby rejected.

5. It is made clear that if the deficit court fee is paid within a period of one month, then Office shall register the appeal as miscellaneous appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act, otherwise,
appeal shall stand NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:28114 2 MCC-332-2025 dismissed under Order 7 Rule 11 CPC.

( G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE AKS Smt Deepa Baghel vs Sirajuddin on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25221149/
